description: NaCaLaF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and three longer (2.38 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Ca is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.51 Å. La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of La-F bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one La atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaCa₂La tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Ca, and two equivalent La atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaCaLa₂ tetrahedra.
